rationale: Louan's deep expertise in applied ML pipelines for medical imaging (fMRI, lesion detection, neuroimaging segmentation) and Saurabh's track record shipping AI agents and LLM-adjacent tooling represent complementary skill sets—Louan brings domain-specific model architecture and PyTorch expertise, while Saurabh brings the systems-level thinking and full-stack deployment experience needed to move research into production. intro_message: Louan, meet Saurabh Khire—he's an AI engineer shipping agent and LLM tooling at HiJenny AI, and your neuroimaging ML expertise could pair well with his systems-level thinking if you're looking to prototype something at the hackathon.
